components.name: Roof Surface
components.desc: Metal roofing preferred (cleanest runoff). Avoid asphalt shingles due to toxic petroleum chemicals.

components.name: Gutters & Guards
components.desc: Wide gutters sloped 1/16" per foot, covered with mesh screens to block large leaf debris.

components.name: First Flush Diverter
components.desc: Diverts the first 10-20 gallons of dirty runoff. Requires a slow-draining weep hole to empty itself between storms.

components.name: IBC Totes (275 Gal)
components.desc: Heavy-duty poly tanks housed in steel cages. MUST be wrapped in black/green tarp to block sunlight and prevent algae.

components.name: Indoor Cistern
components.desc: Food-grade polyethylene tanks stored inside a basement or insulated building to prevent freeze-cracking in winters.
